svg.title: SAR drone software roadmap
svg.desc: Development foundation and ROS setup is the current focus. Simulation and SAR interfaces come next, with interface design in parallel with simulation setup. The final phase is the baseline SAR mission and onboard integration. Early hardware checks can overlap simulation.

g.text: Baseline SAR mission and onboard integration
Current focus · Tests, linting, ROS setup, and GHCR image pull
Goal · Run a selected image onboard and verify ROS communication
Gazebo and PX4 SITL · Basic flight and telemetry
Design SAR interfaces alongside simulation setup
Search, detect, estimate location, and report
Verify on the bench, then in supervised flight
Early camera and hardware checks can overlap simulation.
